sections.title: Section 11 - Instructions to Deputy Commissioner of Taxes The authority under which the Commissioner of Taxes is subordinate to the Income Tax Authori
sections.content_text: Section 11 - Instructions to Deputy Commissioner of Taxes The authority under which the Commissioner of Taxes is subordinate to the Income Tax Authority or any other person empowered in this behalf by the Board may assist or give direction or instructions to the Commissioner of Taxes while conducting any proceedings under this Act.
